docs.description: Use for architecture, bugfix reports, and project documentation conventions

prisma.description: Use for database schema, migrations, and seed data reference

next-docs.description: Use for Next.js API reference, breaking changes, and framework conventions

memory.description: Use for persistent session memory, project decisions, preferences, and reusable knowledge across sessions

senior-dev.description: Ultimate senior full-stack developer with integrated web research, code review, debugging, second-brain memory, and parallel subagent orchestration. Handles everything automatically without needing explicit agent calls.

researcher.description: Web research specialist. Finds, analyzes, and synthesizes information from web searches, documentation, and online sources.

reviewer.description: Senior code reviewer. Audits code for bugs, security, performance, and maintainability.

architect.description: Systems architect. Designs architecture, evaluates trade-offs, plans implementations, and documents technical decisions.

debugger.description: Debugging specialist. Systematically isolates root causes, reproduces bugs, and verifies fixes.

second-brain.description: Knowledge manager. Reads, writes, and organizes persistent project memory. Stores decisions, patterns, preferences, and reusable knowledge.

lint.description: Run linter and fix auto-fixable issues
lint.template: Run `npm run lint` and fix any issues found

typecheck.template: Run `npm run typecheck` and fix any type errors found

test.template: Run `npm run test` and fix any failures

build.description: Run full build to verify production readiness
build.template: Run `npm run build` and fix any build errors found

check.description: Run all checks: lint, typecheck, test, build
check.template: Run lint check first with `npm run lint`, then typecheck with `npm run typecheck`, then tests with `npm run test`, then build with `npm run build`. Fix issues at each step before proceeding to the next.

migrate.description: Create a new Prisma migration after schema changes
migrate.template: Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name $ARGUMENTS` to create a new migration

prisma-studio.description: Open Prisma Studio for database inspection

remember.description: Save a note to second brain memory
remember.template: Save this to second brain memory: $ARGUMENTS

recall.description: Search second brain memory for stored knowledge

research.description: Research a topic using web search and firecrawl

parallel.description: Execute multiple workstreams in parallel on a complex task
